lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the July 15 HARC meeting, where the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple new buildings in Backman Village — goes before the commission for Preliminary Large-Scale public hearings. That same day, the Board of County Commissioners takes up two Land Use Code amendments, including one on natural medicine businesses and another on nonconforming lots, both the kind of code language that shapes what gets built and where for years to come. HARC also reviews accessibility and renovation work at Town Hall and the Parks & Rec building on the 15th, and the Open Space Commission holds a Valley Floor weed pull Monday at 4pm with public comment open to anyone who shows up.

notable.stake: Multi-building Carhenge redevelopment gets its first large-scale public hearings.
County votes on Land Use Code changes for natural medicine businesses and nonconforming lots.
HARC reviews alterations to two landmark Town-owned civic buildings.
Public comment is open at Monday's Valley Floor site walk.
